Translation: Glory be to the Majestic God

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَنْبَغِيْ التَّسْبِيحُ إِلَّا لَهُ
Translation: Glory be to the One whom glorification is only befitting for Him
Glory be to the Most Honorable, the Most Generous

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْعِزَّ وَهُوَ لَهُ اَهْلٌ
Translation: Glory be to the One who is clothed in might, and He is worthy of it
